ja: ホビーショーや全国の模型店店頭で上映された「頑駄無異歩流武十四」の主人公・頑駄無大将軍のＢＢ戦士プラモデルです。軽装形態から光の鎧装着形態にパワーアップ！光の鎧は着脱式です。映像中最大の見せ場である「飛翔鳳翼斬」を、鎧の可動とスプリング展開ギミックで再現可能。
en: This is a BB warrior plastic model of Gundam Taishogun, the main character of "Gundam Ippo-ryu Bujushi", which was shown at hobby shows and model stores nationwide. Power up from light armored form to light armored form! The armor of light is removable. The biggest highlight in the video, "Flying Phoenix Wing Slash," can be recreated with the movable armor and spring deployment gimmick.
